narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Units make seventeen, tenths make nine, and hundredths make twelve. I write seventeen and nine tenths and twelve hundredths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But twelve hundredths is more than ten hundredths, so it holds a whole tenth.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A place cannot hold twelve, so the extra ten carries to the left.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Add place by place, and carry every ten to the place on its left.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Add three and four tenths and seven hundredths to one and five tenths and six hundredths.
